input.value: Rear-ended by other vehicle traveling at approximately 35 mph with no braking
Totaled; entire trunk crushed into back seat
Insurance details available on police report

input.rationale: This is a motor vehicle collision causing severe damage to the policyholder's vehicle and bodily injury to the policyholder, clearly within auto coverage.

Totaled vehicle (well above $25,000 damage threshold) combined with reportable injuries (whiplash and sprained wrist) to the policyholder requiring adjuster attention and possible medical documentation.

input.claim_summary: Pat Morgan (POL-1003) was rear-ended on Route 9 at approximately 8:15 AM yesterday by a vehicle traveling 35 mph without braking. The vehicle is totaled with the trunk crushed into the back seat. Pat sustained whiplash and a sprained wrist. Other driver's insurance information is documented on the police report.
